en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a parade or public demonstration, likely from the early-to-mid 20th century. In the foreground, men in traditional uniforms march while holding hats and a large flag. Behind them, a banner is being carried with a map and Cyrillic text. Many people are gathered, some watching from windows and balconies, and the street is lined with multi-story buildings with commercial signage in Cyrillic. The event seems patriotic or nationalistic.
